List GovernanceFrameworkVersion entries for one owning subject, either an Ecosystem or a Corporation (IDX-GF-QRY-2). Aligned with VPR MOD-GF-QRY-2. Exactly one of ecosystem_id and corporation_id must be provided, otherwise HTTP 400. Each entry has the same shape as Get Governance Framework Version. Within a subject, ascending id equals ascending version.
